name: nemawashi
title_zh: 动手写代码前先问清谁会被你改到的人
tagline_zh: 需求含糊、架构没定、改动牵一发动全身的时候，它先逼你把目标、约束、利益相关方和风险摊开写清楚，再放你动手。
tagline_en: When requirements are vague or a change ripples wide, it forces goals, constraints, stakeholders and risks onto.
desc_en: Clarify software goals, constraints, stakeholders, and risks before consequential design or implementation work. Use for greenfield ideas, ambiguous requirements, architecture decisions, or changes where misunderstanding would be costly.
why_zh: 它不产出方案，只产出共识：把「谁在意、怕什么、不能碰什么」逐条问出来，答不上来就不往下走。
why_en: It doesn't produce a design, it produces alignment: it interrogates who cares, what they fear, what can't move — and won't.
limit_zh: 纯探索性原型、一次性脚本、你自己说了算的小改动别用，它会拖慢你；它只到「问题定义清楚」为止，不写代码、不选技术栈。
limit_en: Skip for throwaway prototypes, one-off scripts, or changes you alone own — it will slow you down. It stops at a clear problem statement: no code, no.
title_en: Ask who your change breaks before you write code
